tasks_completed.description: Insert notifyDaemonOfCodexTid call at the abortTurnWithFallback forced-restart reconnect site (third tid-bind site, M3)
tasks_completed.changes: Added 7-line block inside `if (abortResult.forcedRestart)` in handleAbort() at runCodex.ts line ~370. When `abortResult.resumedThread === true` and `client.threadId` is non-null, calls `session.updateMetadata` merging codexThreadId into current metadata and invokes `notifyDaemonOfCodexTid(session.sessionId, client.threadId!, u)`. Import for notifyDaemonOfCodexTid was already present at line 28.
tasks_completed.rationale: The forced-restart path in abortTurnWithFallback (codexAppServerClient.ts:986) calls reconnectAndResumeThread() which internally runs thread/resume and updates this._threadId. The returned `resumedThread: boolean` only indicates success but does not expose the new tid. The public getter `client.threadId` (line 175) exposes it. Mirroring the M1 pattern at runCodex.ts:710-714 ensures the daemon learns the tid regardless of which path bound it.

git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: The forced-restart reconnect path in abortTurnWithFallback acquires a thread ID (via reconnectAndResumeThread -> resumeThread -> this._threadId = result.thread.id) but never reported it to the daemon, leaving the daemon's in-memory TrackedSession and codex-mapping.json stale after a forced restart.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: After abortTurnWithFallback when forcedRestart=true and resumedThread=true, reads client.threadId (the fresh tid post-reconnect) and calls notifyDaemonOfCodexTid, which POSTs to daemon /session-started with enriched metadata containing codexThreadId and sets process.title.

All 16 codexAppServerClient unit tests pass. self_verification.notes: yarn build completed in 13.11s with zero TypeScript errors. notifyDaemonOfCodexTid unit tests 11/11 pass. codexAppServerClient unit tests 16/16 pass. Pre-existing integration failures unrelated to this change.

recommendations: Consider adding a dedicated unit test for the M3 site in runCodex.ts that mocks abortTurnWithFallback to return {forcedRestart:true, resumedThread:true} and verifies notifyDaemonOfCodexTid is called with the correct threadId.
